en.headline: Remand prisoner in 1991 Sham Shui Po murder case dies after collapsing in court cells
en.dek: The 62-year-old man, who had late-stage lung cancer, was found unconscious during a High Court hearing and later certified dead in hospital; a death inquest will follow.
body: A 62-year-old remand prisoner charged in connection with a 1991 murder and attempted robbery in Sham Shui Po collapsed in a High Court cell on Monday and later died in hospital.

The Correctional Services Department said the man, who had been receiving treatment for lung cancer with brain metastasis, was found unconscious in a single cell at about 1:48pm. Staff performed first aid and he was taken to a public hospital, where he was certified dead at 3:28pm. The department has notified the police and a death inquest will be held.

The man had been remanded since 2023 after being arrested on arrival from the mainland. A jury had earlier found him unfit to plead because of his medical condition. The High Court was continuing proceedings on the facts of the case when the incident occurred.

zh.headline: 1991年深水埗劫殺案被告羈留室昏迷送院不治
zh.dek: 62歲患肺癌還押男犯周一在高等法院應訊期間昏倒，下午證實死亡，死因庭將研訊。
body: 一名62歲還押在囚人士周一被安排到高等法院應訊，期間在羈留室內昏迷，送院後不治。他被控涉及1991年深水埗北河街一宗謀殺及企圖搶劫案。
懲教署表示，該名男子患有肺癌，一直接受治療。懲教人員下午約1時48分發現他在單人囚室昏迷，立即急救並送往公立醫院，下午3時28分證實死亡。署方已通知警方，死因裁判法庭將進行死因研訊。
該男子2023年由內地來港時被捕並還押。早前陪審團因他的病情裁定他不適合答辯，法庭其後繼續就事實進行聆訊。
